content: Kadaudok en Suda oh Simion Kalowehdi Adonipesek
Mwurin mehlahn Sosua mehn Israel ahpw kalelapak rehn KAUN-O, patohwan, “Mehnia rehn kadaudokat kan me pahn tiengla oh mahweniong mehn Kenan kan?”
KAUN-O ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Kadaudok en Suda me pahn tiengla. I pahn mweidohng irail re en kaunda sahpwo.”

Mehn Suda ko eri ndahng mehn Simion ko, ‘Kumwail iang kiht kohla nan sahpw me kileldiong kiht, oh kitail ehupene mahweniong mehn Kenan kan. Mwuhr se pahn uhd iang kumwail kohwei nan sahpw me kileldiong kumwail.” Eri, kadaudok en Simion oh
kadaudok en Suda ahpw ehupene kohla mahwen. KAUN-O eri ketikihong irail re en powehdi mehn Kenan kan oh mehn Peres kan; irail eri koledi ohlen Pesek nen.
Re ahpw diarada Adonipesek wasao, irail eri mahweniong.
E tangdoaui, re ahpw pwakihala oh koledi oh lupukasang sendinpehlap ko oh sendinnehlap ko.

Adonipesek ahpw mahsanih, “Nanmwarki isiakan I lupukasang sendinpehlaparail ko oh sendinnehlaparail ko, irail eri kin tungutungoale mweremwer en mwenge pahn ei tehpel. Eri, Koht ketin wiahiongieier dahme I wiahiong irailo.” Ih eri wisikla Serusalem wasa e sipalla ie.
Kadaudok en Suda Kalowehdi Serusalem oh Epron
Kadaudok en Suda mahweniong Serusalem oh kalowehdi. Re ahpw kemehla towe kan oh isikala kahnimwo.
Mwurin met re ahpw douluhlla oh mahweniong mehn Kenan kan me koukousoan wasa nahnahn kan, ni tepin dohl akan oh nan wasa madekeng en palieir.
Re ahpw uhd kolahng mahweniong tohn Kenan kan me kin kousoan nan kahnimw Epron, me mahs adaneki Kiriad Arpa. Re ahpw kalowehdi peneineien Sesai, Aiman, oh Talmai wasao.
Odniel Kalowehdi Kahnimw Depir
Ohlen Suda ko ahpw mwekidsang wasao oh kolahng mahweniong tohn kahnimw Depir, me adaneki Kiriad Seper ni ahnsowo.
Emen irail me adaneki Kalep ahpw patohwan, “I pahn kihong nei serepein Aksa en pwoudiki ohl emen me pahn kalowehdi Kiriad Seper.”
Odniel, nein rien Kalep me tikitik ede Kenas, eri kalowehdi kahnimwo, Kalep eri kihong en pwoudiki nah serepein Aksa.
Ni rahnen kapwopwoudo, Odniel ahpw koangngoangehki serepeino en peki rehn eh pahpao en kihong ehu peliensapwen. Serepeino eri doudihsang pohn were ahso, a Kalep ahpw idek reh dahme e anahne.
E ahpw sapeng, patohwan, “I anahne ekei pwareren. Sahpw me komw ketikihongieo me madekeng.” Kalep eri kihong pwarer kei me mi palipah oh palipowe.
Kadaudok en Suda oh Pensamin Kalowehdi ekei Wasa
Kadaudok en semen en Moses eh pwoud, mehn Ken, iangada tohn Suda sang Seriko, kolahng sapwtehn en palieir en Arad nan Suda. Re ahpw soandiong wasao rehn mehn Amalek kan.
Kadaudok en Suda iangahki kadaudok en Simion; irail ahpw kalowehdi mehn Kenan kan me kin kousoan nan kahnimw Sepad. Re ahpw keriahla kahnimwo, kamwomwala oh kahdanekihla Orma.

KAUN-O ketin sewese mehn Suda ko, irail ahpw koledi sahpw nahnahno. Ahpw re sohte kalowehdi Kasa, Askelon, Ekron oh sahpw akan me kapilirailpene. Aramas pwukat me kin koukousoan ni oaroahr, re waraneki werennansapw mete, kahrehda mehn Suda ko sohte kak kasareirailla.
Duwen Moses eh koasoanehdi, Epron kohieng Kalep, me kasarehsang nan kahnimwo keinek siluh me kadaudok en Anak.
Ahpw kadaudok en Pensamin sohte kasarehla mehn Sepus kan me kousoan Serusalem. Mehn Sepus kan eri uselahte kousoan Serusalem rehn kadaudok en Pensamin sang ahnsowo kohdo.
Kadaudok en Epraim oh Manase Kalowehdi Kahnimw Pedel
Kadaudok en Epraim oh Manase kohla mahweniong kahnimw Pedel me ahnsowo adaneki Lus. KAUN-O ketin seweseirailda. Re kadaralahng nan kahnimwo lipoahrok kei
me tuhwong ohl emen me kohkohsang nan kahnimwo. Re ahpw ndahng, “Menlau padahkihong kiht ahlen kolahng nan kahnimwen, se ahpw sohte pahn wiahiong komwi mehkot suwed.”
Ih eri padahkihong irail. Kadaudok en Epraim oh Manase eri kemehla tohn kahnimwo koaros, ihte ohl menet oh eh peneinei me sohte kamakamala.
Ohlo eri kohla nan sapwen mehn Id kan oh kauwada kahnimw ehu wasao, oh kihong ede Lus me e adanekihte lel rahnwet.
Aramas akan me mehn Israel Sohte Kasarehsang nan ar Wasa
Kadaudok en Manase sohte kasarehsang nan kahnimw kan en Ped Sean, Taanak, Dor, Ipleam, Mekiddo oh kahnimw keren kan aramas ako me kin kousoan wasa pwuko; mehn Kenan ko uselahte koukousoan wasa ko.
Ahnsou me mehn Israel ko kehlaillahr, re itonehng mehn Kenan ko pwe re en doadoahk ong irail, ahpw re sohte kasarehla irail koaros.
Kadaudok en Epraim sohte kasarehla mehn Kenan me kin kousoan nan kahnimw Keser, kahrehda mehn Kenan ko uselahte koukousoan rehrail.

Kadaudok en Sepulon sohte kasarehla aramas ako me kin koukousoan nan kahnimw kan en Kitron oh Nahalal, ihme mehn Kenan ko usehlahte koukousoan rehrail wasao oh re itoit ong re en kin doadoahk ong irail.
Kadaudok en Aser sohte kasarehla aramas ako me koukousoan nan kahnimw kan en Akko, Saidon, Ahlap, Aksip, Elpa, Apek oh Rehop.
Mehn Aser ko kousoan rehn mehn Kenan ko, pwehki ar sohte pakasarala.
Kadaudok en Napdali sohte kasarehla irail ko me koukousoan nan kahnimw kan en Ped Semes oh Pedanad. Mehn Napdali ko kousoan rehn mehn Kenan ko, re ahpw itonehng irail re en doadoahk ong irail.
Mehn Amor itonehng kadaudok en Dan re en kohkohla nan sahpw nahnahn oh sohte mweidohng irail en kohdihla nan sahpw patapato.
Mehn Amor uselahte koukousoan Aisalon, Salpim oh Nahna Eres, ahpw kadaudok en Epraim oh Manase kakaun irailte oh itonehng pwe re en kin doadoahk ong irail.
Paliepeng en Sela, irepen mehn Edom tang ni Wasahn Kot en Akrappim.
